_comment: Single-stage prefix-scale study for twophase+onephase on Rocketfuel AS 1755 (172 nodes: 111 core + 61 edge, 381 links). No snapshot: each run starts from scratch — DV converges first via RegisterRoutingConvergedCallback, then edge nodes announce prefixes, then tables are read at simTime. Run with: sudo ./jobs.sh start --fresh prefix_scale/rocketfuel_1755_bothphase_nosnap
name: rocketfuel_1755_bothphase_nosnap
description: Single-stage Rocketfuel AS 1755 prefix-scale table study (twophase+onephase): DV convergence and prefix announcement happen in one simulation run per prefix count. No snapshot import/export.
